capture_through_shield: Original perf_counter from feedback capture start through the FEEDBACK Shield role, before the trailing active check and IK.
native_window: Actual controller sample_and_ik_s plus final rejection rounded to 0.001 milliseconds.
outer_remainder: Same window subtraction. Includes first active (owner and hard state), trailing active (owner and hard state), final target checks, native IK and surrounding Python work.
unsplit_native_stages: individual lease SQL and hard_state latency
wall_clock_roles: Actual UTC stamps recorded at MuJoCo camera start, after validated camera observation, and after the Shield. Acquisition includes rendering and RGB-D encoding/validation. The interval after acquisition includes provider, contract copies, Shield and intervening glue. The UTC role checks and monotonic timer have different endpoints.
